text:
maria: Quick heads-up — kicking off a shadow-run for a blended quant variant for long-doc summarization (v2-int4 + nf4 mix). Starting at 1% shadow traffic against rwd-v1-large baseline. Plan: 1% -> 5% -> 10% if signals look good.

alex: Nice. What exactly are we measuring for 'signals'?

maria: Primary: concordance (extractive overlap + entailment score) and an hallucination classifier rate. Secondary: ROUGE-L median shift, answer faithfulness checks from our evaluation harness.

jun: Can you paste the gating thresholds so SRE/prod can mirror them in the console?

maria: Sure — short version:
```
# gate config (human-readable)
- safety: hallucination_rate_delta_absolute <= 0.3% (vs baseline)
- quality: median_ROUGE-L_relative >= -1.5 pts
- hard-fail: median_ROUGE-L_drop > 2.5 pts OR hallucination_rate_absolute > 1.0%
- duration: require 48h continuous sample at each step
- min-sample: 5k shadow requests per step
```

sasha: Heads-up on perf: on local prod-like runs p95 token latency increased ~30ms, cost +~6% for the blend. Is that acceptable?

maria: That's within our cost/latency budget for a staged promote. We'll keep a latency SLO monitor and trigger an autofallback if p95 regression >50ms.

alex: Who's owning the automatic fallback policy (alert -> rollback)? Is it the rollout service or manual?

maria: Rollout service will auto-fallback if any hard-fail triggers. For soft signals (small ROUGE dip / hallucination bump) we'll open a quiet-burn and notify the models channel + oncall. Manual override stays with release owner.

jun: I'll wire the eval hooks and add the entailment classifier threshold to the console. Expect a patch by EOD.

deploy-bot: shadow run started for model rwd-v2-int4-nf4-blend @ 2024-09-02T14:10:56Z (1% shadow) :rocket:

oncall-bot: Noted. On-call pagers will fire for hard-fail and latency SLO breach.

alex: Suggest we add a small sample of adversarial prompts (legal/finance) to the smoke evals — those slices historically expose hallucination regressions.

maria: Good call. Adding a 10% weighted slice for legal/finance prompts during the 1% -> 5% step.

sasha: If we see oscillation in the metric (up/down), do we hold or roll back?

maria: Hold + increase sample size and extend the step for another 24h. Only rollback on persistent hard-fail or clear directional degradation beyond hysteresis window.

alex: 👍 thanks. I'll review alerts and add a concordance dashboard tile.

jun: Patch linked: https://redir.console/internal/patches/1234 — includes eval hooks and entailment threshold.

maria: Thanks team — will post periodic updates here. If anyone sees anything noisy from the initial shadow slice ping me directly.
